description: Puts a video NOT made on aicut (an upload, or a public https MP4/MOV link) on this account as a finished video; returns the `id` for `prepare_post`. Free. A local file: upload it, pass the `confirm_upload` url. A link costs one ingest slot. Only import what the user may post. IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

url.description: The upload url or https link.
